input.oldString:
create_desktop_entry() {
    print_status "Creating desktop entry..."
    
    # Get the user's local applications directory
    LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/applications"
    mkdir -p "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR"
    
    cat > "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR/propscan.desktop" << EOF
[Desktop Entry]
Version=1.0
Type=Application
Name=PropScan
Comment=Scan for proprietary software on Linux systems
Exec=propscan
Icon=security-high
Terminal=true
Categories=System;Security;
Keywords=proprietary;software;scan;package;manager;
EOF
    
    print_success "Desktop entry created."
}
input.newString:
create_desktop_entry() {
    print_status "Creating desktop entry..."
    
    # Get the user's local applications directory
    LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/applications"
    mkdir -p "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR"
    
    cat > "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR/propscan.desktop" << EOF
[Desktop Entry]
Version=1.0
Type=Application
Name=PropScan
Comment=Scan for proprietary software on Linux systems
Exec=$HOME/.local/bin/propscan
Icon=security-high
Terminal=true
Categories=System;Security;
Keywords=proprietary;software;scan;package;manager;
EOF
    
    print_success "Desktop entry created."
}
